# `/role-mining-sessions` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /role-mining-sessions/v1

`createRoleMiningSessionsV1` — Create a role mining session — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This submits a create role mining session request to the role mining application.

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- Body (application/json): roleminingsessiondto
- Returns 201: roleminingsessionresponse

### GET /role-mining-sessions/v1

`getRoleMiningSessionsV1` — Retrieves all role mining sessions — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns all role mining sessions that match the query parameters

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage, iai:access-modeling:read
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: saved: eq; name: eq, sw — e.g. `saved eq "true" and name sw "RM Session"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: createdBy, createdDate — e.g. `createdBy,createdDate`
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of roleminingsessiondto

### PATCH /role-mining-sessions/v1/{sessionId}

`patchRoleMiningSessionV1` — Patch a role mining session — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

The method updates an existing role mining session using PATCH. Supports op in {"replace"} and changes to pruneThreshold and/or minNumIdentitiesInPotentialRole. The potential roles in this role mining session is then re-calculated.

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- Parameters:
  - `sessionId` (path, required) — The role mining session id to be patched
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 202: object

### GET /role-mining-sessions/v1/{sessionId}/potential-role-summaries/{potentialRoleId}

`patchPotentialRoleSessionV1` — Update a potential role session — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

### GET /role-mining-sessions/v1/{sessionId}/potential-roles/{potentialRoleId}/export

`exportRoleMiningPotentialRoleV1` — Export (download) details for a potential role in a role mining session — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint downloads all the information for a potential role in a role mining session. Includes identities and entitlements in the potential role.

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage, iai:access-modeling:read
- Parameters:
  - `sessionId` (path, required) — The role mining session id
  - `potentialRoleId` (path, required) — A potential role id in a role mining session
- Returns 200: no body

### POST /role-mining-sessions/v1/{sessionId}/potential-roles/{potentialRoleId}/export-async

`exportRoleMiningPotentialRoleAsyncV1` — Asynchronously export details for a potential role in a role mining session and upload to S3 — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint uploads all the information for a potential role in a role mining session to S3 as a downloadable zip archive. Includes identities and entitlements in the potential role.

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- Parameters:
  - `sessionId` (path, required) — The role mining session id
  - `potentialRoleId` (path, required) — A potential role id in a role mining session
- Body (application/json): roleminingpotentialroleexportrequest
- Returns 202: roleminingpotentialroleexportresponse

### POST /role-mining-sessions/v1/{sessionId}/potential-roles/{potentialRoleId}/provision

`createPotentialRoleProvisionRequestV1` — Create request to provision a potential role into an actual role. — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This method starts a job to provision a potential role

- Scopes: iai:access-modeling:manage
- Parameters:
  - `sessionId` (path, required) — The role mining session id
  - `potentialRoleId` (path, required) — A potential role id in a role mining session
  - `min-entitlement-popularity` (query) — max 100 — default 0 — Minimum popularity required for an entitlement to be included in the provisioned role.
  - `include-common-access` (query) — default True — Boolean determining whether common access entitlements will be included in the provisioned role.
- Body (application/json): roleminingpotentialroleprovisionrequest
- Returns 202: roleminingpotentialrolesummary
